newsitem.title: THAILAND: Dhana Siam clarifies loans to Univest.
newsitem.headline: Dhana Siam clarifies loans to Univest.

text.p: Dhana Siam Finance and Securities Plc said on Thursday it and other financial institutions had extended about one billion baht collaterised loans to Univest Land Plc.
But the debt was not expected to hurt its financial position, Dhana Siam said.

Dhana Siam said in a filing to the Stock Exchange of Thailand the loan was backed sufficiently by a suburban plot of land. It did not say how much it had lent to Univest, an office and residential project developer.

Dhana Siam fell by a 10 percent limit low on Wednesday on rumours that it was hurt by loans extended to Univest. The finance and brokerage firm dipped a further 1.75 baht to 37.50 in overall bearish market sentiment mid-morning Thursday.
Dhana Siam denied it faced liquidity problems, saying the company's operating fund stood at 11.37 billion baht at end- December.
The firm said its current provision for doubtful and sub-standard assets of 740 million baht was higher than the level set by the Bank of Thailand.
